cpu.note: Scaled CPU policies round to nearest core, ties upward, minimum one core. An explicit quantum changes the rounding granularity. Core/private-cache and shared L3 areas scale by rounded core count / reference core count; no independent cache-capacity rounding. This is a design assumption, not a physical cluster claim.

memory.note: Width-only PHY scaling at reference LPDDR technology; 16-bit design granularity. Controller area is unidentified and included in residual, not independently calibrated.
memory.shoreline_note: For package-level integration, total LPDDR PHY length is the sum of vertical strip heights converted with die height, scaled by target/reference bus width. Require length <= 2*sqrt(final SoC area). Explicit target length override is supported.

measurement.method: Manual approximate rectangular measurements of the user-provided annotated image. Coordinates are half-open [left, top, right, bottom], excluding outer text strips. Pixel areas converted using inherited 26x16 mm die dimensions. GPU parameters retained from Thor_die_mm.json; only non-GPU regions measured here. No independent accuracy validation. Latest revision separately counts system_components as fixed per-die area; previous residual classification is superseded.

cpu_cores_and_private_cache.note: 14 physical CPU cores in two image groups; grouping does not assert cluster topology.

cpu_shared_l3.note: Shared CPU cache region; capacity not inferred from picture.

dsp.note: User-labelled DSP region treated as optional vision accelerator; included in reference calibration, excluded from custom SoCs by default. Identification is a die-shot assumption, not independently verified hardware equivalence to Orin PVA.

video_codec.note: Retained even though embedded spatially within the GPU envelope; excluded from legacy compute-complex model.

display_subsystem.note: Fixed on every base die by default; can be explicitly excluded with display PHY.

display_phy.note: Approximate labelled HDMI/DP strip; assumes dedicated display logic.

memory_phy.note: LPDDR PHY strips; controller not separately identified.

camera_phy.note: CSI strips; capture/control infrastructure outside strips remains in residual.

pcie_phy.note: Retained reference PCIe strips; controller/system logic remains in residual.

system_components.note: Fixed System Components envelope from latest user annotation, inside red stroke. Registered to existing crop without changing other modules. Includes system support as a bundle; internal functions are not separately measured.

scope: Identified System Components is a fixed per-die bundle. Only other unidentified logic, fabric and physical whitespace remain proportional residual.
No extra utilization multiplier: measured boxes already contain local layout overhead.
Residual is calibrated with ALL reference modules, including display and video; display is retained by default; explicit display removal occurs only after calibration.
New D2D/C2C interfaces require caller-specified PHY+controller+adapter+buffer area; existing PCIe is retained and not silently repurposed.
Only an aggregate two-edge square-die memory shoreline check is implemented for package integration; no detailed floorplan, frequency scaling, power, cost or CPU-performance model.
DSP is included in reference calibration but excluded from custom SoCs by default; identified System Components remains fixed.
